pkgconf has only build dependency paths: the pinned FFmpeg port declares vcpkg-pkgconfig-get-modules as a host dependency, and that helper runs tools/pkgconf/pkgconf to query module flags while FFmpeg is built.

reviewed_exceptions.selected_terms: LicenseRef-DXC-LICENSE-TXT-NCSA, the University of Illinois/NCSA licence that opens DirectXShaderCompiler's LICENSE.TXT
evidence: Pinned vcpkg port manifest ports/directx-dxc/vcpkg.json (SHA-256 07644f91eddadf7504300ccb14f2ec2ad62c1ff0674d5392c8c4a687f3db5b2f) declares an explicit null license field; installed SPDX 2.3 licenseConcluded is LicenseRef-vcpkg-null.

The portfile downloads the Microsoft release linux_dxc_2026_05_26.x86_64.tar.gz of tag v1.9.2602.24, pinned by SHA-512, and installs LICENSE.TXT from that tag (SHA-512 9feaa85ca6d42d5a2d6fe773706bbab8241e78390a9d61ea9061c8f0eeb5a3e380ff07c222e02fbf61af7f2b2f6dd31c5fc87247a94dae275dc0a20cdfcc8c9d) as the port's copyright file.

The licence text recorded here is the first section of that file, the NCSA open source licence. The file also reproduces third-party notices for LLVM's bundled components, and its build- and test-dependency section includes GPL text that applies to build and test dependencies only. copyright_sha256 pins the whole reviewed bundle.

directx-dxc has only build dependency paths: sdl3-shadercross declares it as a dependency and the Alumbra manifest lists sdl3-shadercross with host true. The dxc executable runs from tools/directx-dxc during tools/shaders/generate.py and the shader_outputs_match_sources test, and only on x64-linux because the port supports no macOS target.
Alumbra's binaries embed only the SPIR-V and MSL that DXC and SPIRV-Cross produced; the embedded blobs carry no DXC code.
